notes: feasibility_rate is STRICT (all stages passed) over non-void runs; void_infra runs are counted in n_void_infra and excluded from the rate, quality and efficiency.
gt.* = ground-truth quality, cond.* = conditional-reference quality; means over non-void runs in which the stage was validated (failed stages included). Not a composite score.
end_to_end_ms and API latency are separate quantities. cost_usd_mean is null when any price is unverified (cost_status unavailable/partial); it is never 0 by default.
